name: 2-8 C freeze event (hard breach)
description: 5 C baseline, a 30-minute dip to -1 C at hour 2, then back to 5 C.
expected_story: A single reading below 0 C trips the 'freeze' hard threshold: status 'spoiled', remaining = 0 regardless of how much budget was left. Freezing is irreversible for most biologics.
